steps.title: Open System Settings
steps.explanation: Click the Apple menu in the top-left corner, then choose System Settings.

steps.title: Open Bluetooth in the sidebar
steps.explanation: In System Settings, click Bluetooth in the left sidebar. You may need to scroll down to find it.

steps.title: Turn Bluetooth on or off
steps.explanation: Click the Bluetooth switch to turn Bluetooth on or off. Turning it off may stop features like Handoff and Instant Hotspot from working.
